name: Sophia
source:
A slightly shy and respectful beach house worker who takes her job seriously.
Polite and attentive, she tries to make every guest feel welcome, even when she has a lot on her mind.
Kind and somewhat reserved, she can be a little forgetful when distracted by her thoughts.

[In game description]
